claims.nodeLabel: House Oversight probe into deaths and disappearances of scientists, April 2026
claims.sourceText: Comer and Burlison to Administrator Jared Isaacman, NASA, 20 April 2026, https://oversight.house.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/NASA-Missing-Scientists-Letter_4.20.26.pdf
claims.text: The Committee does not adopt the reporting it relays. Its letters frame their own subject as 'recent unconfirmed public reporting' and footnote every factual assertion to the Daily Mail of 11 April 2026 and to New York Post pieces of 9 April, 18 March and 21 March 2026. They ask four agencies whether those reports are true. What the letters establish is that the Committee asked, and the deadline it set.

claims.sourceText: Comer and Burlison to Administrator Jared Isaacman, NASA, 20 April 2026, https://oversight.house.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/NASA-Missing-Scientists-Letter_4.20.26.pdf
claims.text: The letters name one of the individuals and describe the reported McCasland link in the Committee's own words: 'Another JPL alum, Monica Reza, who served as the director of the NASA Lab's Materials Processing Group, disappeared while hiking in California in June 2025 and remains missing.' They add that accounts 'have even alleged a direct link between Ms. Reza and General McCasland, characterizing them as having a "close professional connection" through an Air Force-funded research program in the early 2000s.' The Committee attributes both to unconfirmed public reporting.

claims.nodeLabel: House Oversight probe into deaths and disappearances of scientists, April 2026
claims.sourceText: Comer and Burlison to Administrator Jared Isaacman, NASA, 20 April 2026, https://oversight.house.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/NASA-Missing-Scientists-Letter_4.20.26.pdf ; the identical letter to Director Kash Patel, FBI, https://oversight.house.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/FBI-Missing-Scientists-Letter_4.20.26.pdf
claims.text: The Committee's own letters of 20 April 2026 say 'at least ten individuals', not eleven, and date the pattern to a year later than the board did: the letters carry the string 'began in 2023 with the death of Michael David Hicks'. Effectively identical letters went to NASA, the FBI, the Department of War and the Department of Energy over the signatures of Chairman James Comer and Subcommittee Chairman Eric Burlison, copied to Ranking Members Garcia and Frost, and set a response deadline of 27 April 2026.

claims.sourceText: Fox News, 21 April 2026, https://www.foxnews.com/politics/missing-scientists-probe-sparked-after-ufo-general-disappeared-republican-lawmaker-reveals ; checked against the Committee letters of 20 April 2026, https://oversight.house.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/NASA-Missing-Scientists-Letter_4.20.26.pdf
claims.text: Fox News reported on 21 April 2026 that Chairman Comer and Rep. Burlison had launched a congressional probe into eleven individuals in nuclear or rocket technology who had died or vanished since 2022, requesting briefings from the FBI, the Department of War, NASA and the Department of Energy by 27 April 2026. The Committee's own letters, opened on 2 September 2026, say 'at least ten individuals' and date the pattern to 2023; the eleven and the 2022 are what Fox reported.
